messages:
alex: Quick handoff — I'm oncall until 23:30 PT. TL;DR: rolling canary finished on dedicated pool in us-west2, one slow node (gpu-3) flagged for elevated p99 on sequences > 4096. Nothing active, but watch tonight's preload job at 01:00 UTC (prefetcher v2) — it can spike KV cache warmups.
priya: noted. where do you want us to watch latency? per-route dashboard or global? :eyes:
alex: start with /models/redwood-ggml-prod and /routes/generation; the per-route p99 and tail queue length. Infra bot will post deploy events.
infra-bot: Deploy started: prefetcher-v2 -> dedicated/us-west2 at 00:55 UTC. Rolling 5 nodes -> 1m/chunk.
sam: tagged in case anyone wants to abort the prefetch deploy if p99 climbs > 2000ms. Also CRD #4523 is still waiting for review (batcher backpressure fix) — Alex, you okay if I merge after you +1?
alex: yes please, merge after 01:10 UTC if prefetcher looks stable. If we see KV cold spikes, revert to prefetcher-v1.
lee: quick FYI — small synthetic load test landed on staging that touches large context paths; might cause noisy alerts for the first 15m after prefetch. I muted the noisy alert rule but not the critical latency SLO rule.
maya: added an ops note in the oncall runbook: "if gpu-3 p99 > 1.5x baseline after prefetch, cordon node and escalate to hw-support". Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-prefetch-guide
alex: action items: 1) watch per-route p99 and tail queue for /models/redwood-ggml-prod, 2) if p99 > 2000ms for >5m -> rollback prefetcher, 3) if gpu-3 shows thermal throttling -> cordon and open hw ticket. I'm reachable on DM.
priya: I'll take first 45m watch then hand to Sam. Sam can you pick up at 00:30 UTC?
sam: yep I got 00:30-02:00 UTC.
lee: pinging @infra-bot for a quick health-check command we can run if we see KV cache thrash.
infra-bot: Healthcheck snippet: ```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood/health/model/redwood-ggml-prod | jq '.latency.p50, .latency.p99, .kv.cache_hit_rate'
```
maya: also FYI we have a scheduled maintenance window for Dedicated storage snapshots 03:00-03:30 UTC in us-west2. Not a blocker but don't start large background jobs during that window.
alex: perfect. thanks all — will post a follow-up if anything changes. :thumbsup:
